title: lophiolepis haussknechtii
intro: Lophiolepis haussknechtii, commonly known as the Haussknecht's Lophiolepis, is a plant species belonging to the family Aspleniaceae. It has been traditionally used in medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties.
